setup: An angle has sine $[[opp]]/[[hyp]]$ from a right triangle, and you are asked for the sine of three times the angle.

steps.say: The triple-angle formula for the sine is $\sin 3t = 3\sin t - 4\sin^{3} t$, so it needs only the sine of the original angle, which is $[[opp]]/[[hyp]]$.
Substituting gives $3 \cdot [[opp]]/[[hyp]] - 4 \cdot ([[opp]]/[[hyp]])^{3}$, and combining over the common denominator $[[hyp]]^{3}$ leaves [[answer]].

answer: So the sine of three times the angle is [[answer]].
